_comment: Tune the gateway here; values override the built-in defaults in src/gateway/policy.py. Reload Claude Code after editing.
_takeover_comment: true = git, gh, hf, pijul, asiml/dvc, az, databricks, ssh/scp/rsync-to-host, docker/podman registry commands, skopeo, oras and crane in Bash are redirected to the gateway's account tools. Keep false here: `pixi run install --strict` turns it on in config/local.json (gitignored), which wins.
_approvals_comment: auto = run, refuse = never run, ask = needs approval. Real approvals come from Claude Code's permission prompt ('ask' rules in settings.json, e.g. port_check, run_privileged_confirm), so tools gated there are 'auto' here to avoid a second prompt. An 'ask' tier here uses an MCP form, which the desktop app auto-cancels, so in practice it means refuse. run_privileged is decided by the per-host sudo switch; 'refuse' turns it off entirely.
_vault_comment: Secrets and sudo passwords live in the gateway's own vault, managed with /gate:secret and /gate:sudo.
